class.name: SteamHttpResponseOperation
class.brief_description: Retained, cancellable operation for one submitted Steam HTTP request.
class.description: Use [method wait] to await a terminal outcome and [method cancel] to stop a pending request.

method.name: is_finished
method.description: Return whether the operation has settled.

method.name: result
method.description: Return the terminal result, or [code]null[/code] while pending.

method.name: wait
method.description: Return the completion signal while pending or the stored [SteamHttpResponseResult] after settlement. Awaiting again returns the same result.

method.name: cancel
method.description: Cancel the local request on the main thread. A successful cancellation settles the operation with [constant ERR_SKIP]. Return [constant ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST] if the request is no longer pending.

signal.name: completed
signal.description: Emitted once after the native request and its callback routing are retired. The result carries the transport outcome and any complete HTTP response.
